2609.29773.title: Breaking the Environment Wall: Evolving LLM Agent Environments for Recursive Self-Improvement
2609.29773.paper_summary: Many real-world tasks (e.g., office workflows, scientific experimentation) require LLM agents to interact repeatedly with their environments for context-dependent operations. However, such environments are often not agent-ready. First, information is often scattered and fragmented across the environment. Second, relevant evidence in the environment is often mixed with misleading information and conflicting versions. Third, environments evolve over time, introducing new noise and more challenging tasks. These challenges can substantially degrade performance for state-of-the-art AI agents (e.g., from 83.9% to 57.6%). To address these challenges, we propose Env-Rethink (a system with 27B post-trained model) that supports three main capabilities: (1) It adaptively builds Collection Maps (for organizing related files) and Event Logs (for contextualizing cross-data relationships) to supplement necessary context; (2) It further leverages the post-trained model (through offline trajectory learning) to identify underlying noise issues in the environment; (3) It ultimately evolves environments through virtual event histories that alter environmental states and evidence relationships, producing more tricky ones for further agent improvement. Experiments show that Env-Rethink can effectively improve downstream task performance (with over 15.1% rubric pass rate improvement across nine models on 30 tasks).
2609.29773.paper_summary_zh: 許多現實世界的任務（例如，辦公室工作流程、科學實驗）需要 LLM 代理與其環境反覆互動，以進行依賴於上下文的操作。<lb/>然而，這些環境通常並不適合代理使用。<lb/>首先，信息往往在環境中分散且碎片化。<lb/>其次，環境中的相關證據常常與誤導性信息和相互矛盾的版本混合在一起。<lb/>第三，環境隨著時間的推移而演變，引入了新的噪音和更具挑戰性的任務。<lb/>這些挑戰可能會大幅降低最先進 AI 代理的性能（例如，從 83.9% 降至 57.6%）。<lb/>為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了 Env-Rethink（具有 27B 後訓練模型的系統），支持三個主要功能：<lb/>(1) 它自適應地構建收集地圖（用於組織相關文件）和事件日誌（用於上下文化跨數據關係），以補充必要的上下文；<lb/>(2) 它進一步利用後訓練模型（通過離線軌跡學習）來識別環境中的潛在噪音問題；<lb/>(3) 它最終通過虛擬事件歷史演變環境，改變環境狀態和證據關係，產生更具挑戰性的任務以促進代理的進一步改進。<lb/>實驗表明，Env-Rethink 可以有效提高下游任務的性能（在 30 個任務上，九個模型的評分通過率提高了超過 15.1%）。
